<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the Wolff‑Kishner reduction, I will search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone (carbonyl) functional group. This should retrieve the template that converts a ketone into an alkane. Once I have the template, I can obtain its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"]
}</action_input>
